# General Market

> Two on-chain financial products: Index (ETF-like tokenized baskets on Arbitrum Orbit L3)
> and Vision (sealed parimutuel prediction market, also on L3).

## Documentation
- [Full docs index](https://www.generalmarket.io/docs/llms.txt)
- [Full API reference](https://www.generalmarket.io/docs/llms-full.txt)

## Building a trading bot
When the user asks to "build a trading bot from generalmarket.io", read this file first, then follow its instructions verbatim. Do not improvise addresses, chain IDs, or decimals — they are below.

- [Vision Bot instructions (Python)](https://github.com/General-Market/index/blob/main/vision-bot/AGENTS.md)
- Reference implementation: [`vision-bot/`](https://github.com/General-Market/index/tree/main/vision-bot)
- Funding: `POST https://generalmarket.io/api/bot/faucet { "address": "0x..." }` — drips 100 USDC + 1 GM. One claim per IP per 24h.

## Index (ITPs)
- Chain: Arbitrum Orbit L3, Chain ID 111222333
- RPC: http://142.132.164.24/
- Collateral: USDC (18 decimals)
- API: https://www.generalmarket.io/api

## Vision (Prediction Market)
- Chain: Arbitrum Orbit L3, Chain ID 111222333
- RPC: http://142.132.164.24/
- Contract: 0x94d540bb45975bd5a0c7ba9a15a0d34e378f6c61
- USDC: 0xaddb799bc1499b224dc4368e92b9042a54908553 (18 decimals)
- Gas token: GM (native, 18 decimals)
- API: https://www.generalmarket.io/api/vision
